name: pdk-pretix-datasync-fenced-leases
instr:
# Outbound order synchronization with recovery

## Background
We need outbound integrations to recover automatically from interrupted syncs so external orders converge on current data even when an old write arrives late. Pretix dispatches queued updates through Celery; `runperiodic` schedules work.

## Proposal
Recover abandoned outbound work automatically; provider plugins continue to work through `OutboundSyncProvider`.

## Requirements
- A newly placed order reaches its outbound provider, and an email edit through the order REST PATCH reaches it with the latest email within 15 seconds.
- A worker killed during an external upsert leaves work another worker can finish within 15 seconds after a 20-second claim interval and the next `runperiodic`, without manual timeout retry. In-flight items from before the upgrade, without claim metadata, recover within 20 seconds after the next periodic run.
- A live worker can spend longer than one claim interval in a provider call without a second upsert starting concurrently. If that worker is paused, its claim expires, another worker syncs an edited order, and its old upsert arrives late, the external order returns to the latest email within 30 seconds. A former claimant cannot complete or delete another claimant's work.
- An edit during a sync leaves one pending follow-up and produces exactly one subsequent upsert, without simultaneous upserts while the original worker is live. Recoverable provider errors retain their attempt count acr
